criteria.requirement: Add exactly eight marker meshes named `marker-0` through `marker-7`, each using its own `TetrahedronGeometry(0.3, 0)` and its own material.
criteria.action: Start the demo and inspect the live scene graph, marker geometry parameters, materials, ring parameters, and all local marker positions.
criteria.expected: The scene contains inspectionRig with one XZ-plane torus of radius 4 and tube 0.02, plus eight distinct tetrahedron meshes at the specified radius-4 positions. (Tolerance: Positions and rotations within 1e-6; exact object names and counts.)

criteria.action: Pause, reset, invoke step() five times, and inspect the rig and marker transforms at simulation time 1.25.
criteria.expected: Rig rotation.y is 0.3125; marker i has rotation.x = 0.625 + i*pi/4 and rotation.z = -0.25, with unchanged local positions. (Tolerance: Absolute numeric error no greater than 1e-6.)

criteria.requirement: While paused, ArrowRight advances simulation time by exactly `0.25` seconds and immediately applies the new transforms; ArrowRight while running has no effect.
criteria.action: Exercise Space, ArrowRight, and R through keyboard events and compare with direct diagnostics calls, including an attempted step while running.
criteria.expected: Paused steps accumulate in exact 0.25-second increments, running steps are ignored, and reset returns to paused time zero with cleared selection and restored camera and target. (Tolerance: Simulation-time error no greater than 1e-9; camera error no greater than 1e-6.)

criteria.requirement: A marker hit selects the lowest-index intersected marker, changes only that marker to `0xff8000`, and restores every other marker to `0x40c0c0`.
criteria.action: Project a marker's world position through the live camera, dispatch a canvas pointer click there, then click an empty canvas location.
criteria.expected: The hit marker alone becomes orange and flowStatus reports its index; the empty click restores all default colors and reports exactly 'Selected marker: none'. (Tolerance: Exact selected index, status text, and color values.)

criteria.requirement: Continue calling `superFlow.update(simulationTime)` and rendering while paused.
criteria.action: Instrument superFlow.update and renderer rendering, pause for several frames, and record the time arguments and frame activity.
criteria.expected: Both continue to run while paused, and every paused SuperFlow update receives the same frozen simulation time. (Tolerance: Exact equality of paused update timestamps.)

criteria.requirement: Keep orbit and zoom functional, including while paused.
criteria.action: While paused, perform orbit and wheel input and inspect camera position, controls target, and configured control limits.
criteria.expected: Orbit and zoom still change the camera within the original limits, panning remains disabled, and the original SuperFlow remains in the scene. (Tolerance: Camera movement greater than 1e-4 after input; original limits matched exactly.)

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the initial rendered 3D scene and its declared state. Inspect task-relevant depth and geometry across at least three views where appropriate, and inspect composition, materials, lighting, color, and legibility.
Exercise the central interaction and numeric or geometry contract through the visible UI. Verify meaningful scene/state feedback without inventing unrequested controls.
Repeat the boundary, invalid-input, recovery, and reset sequence while inspecting live scene state.
Inspect 1440x900 and 390x844 layouts, including lower controls and keyboard focus. Reload and inspect console/resource diagnostics.
